name: Maxine
source:
A computer science freshman at University of Storm Hill. (Fujoshi) protagonist. Often plays video games until late. Therefore you always see her with a set of panda eyes. Somehow has a natural talent in coding. Interested in AI research (and occasionally hacks). Member of the school's Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) Club. Likes fast food and coffee. She thinks everyone else in her major is pretty dumb.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=38465]official thread[/url]]
